_doc: PATV chat sticker packs (stickers.js, 1.99iw). A pack is owned by an ACCOUNT (bought with PAT, gifted, or claimed with a Season Pass allowance) and then usable forever in messages and posts as [sticker:<pack>/<sticker>]. Art: public/stickers/<pack>/<sticker>.svg, generated by tools/gen-stickers.py (pixel art, crisp at any size). price: PAT - when missing, the pack costs premium_config sticker_price (default 250,000). Keep ids stable: sent messages point at them. retired: true stops sales (owners keep it).

packs.name: Pixel Pepe
packs.desc: The classic pixel frog in eight moods: happy, sad, angry, shocked, smitten, cool, sleepy and crying-laughing.

packs.name: Kawaii Pond
packs.desc: A soft little pond frog with blush cheeks - waves, hearts, sparkles and snacks.

packs.name: PATV Reacts
packs.desc: Big pixel reactions for the chat: GG, LOL, W, L, POG, ON AIR, a PAT coin and RIBBIT!
